description: The file defines a Java interface named Pipeline within the package org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders. It specifies methods for executing a sequence of stages in a data processing pipeline, including execute() and validate().

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: An interface for executing and validating a data processing pipeline with stages defined by expressions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pipeline using the provided input and expression resolver, returning the resulting PipelineElement after all stages are processed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether all configured stage expressions in the pipeline are supported, throwing an exception if an unknown function is encountered.
